description: This file provides utility functions for processing and formatting throughput data, including data rate conversions, chart data preparation, timestamp formatting, and unit determination for network throughput metrics.

methods.name: formatDataRate
methods.description: Converts a data rate in bytes per second into an appropriately scaled unit (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps).

methods.name: calculateDataRate
methods.description: Calculates the data rate for received and transmitted bytes over a specified interval, handling counter resets.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable HH:MM:SS string.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares chart data series (labels and datasets) from an array of throughput data points for visualization.

methods.name: determineYAxisUnit
methods.description: Determines the most appropriate y-axis unit based on the maximum data rate in a series.

methods.name: convertToUnit
methods.description: Converts a data rate in bytes per second to a specified unit for display.
